recommendation: Keep this audit as-is. Do not re-add Device to the Patient compartment unless OO/FHIR-I explicitly reverse the later DeviceAssociation relocation decisions.
issue_request: FHIR-23704 was a Published FHIR-core Device change request, resolved Persuasive for R5, asking why Device was not in the Patient compartment despite having a patient reference.
initial_application: No commit explicitly mentioning FHIR-23704 was found. R5-era history shows commit 49328521 added Device subject to the Patient compartment as part of broader patient-compartment cleanup, matching the period when Device still carried patient association information.
additional_context: Later Published issues FHIR-38904, FHIR-39226, and FHIR-39243 moved patient association out of Device to avoid reusable Device instances carrying patient-identifying history; commit 97e59d026 removed Device from the Patient compartment and commented out Device association/search parameters. FHIR-51498 later updated Device-related compartments without adding Device itself to Patient.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current build-scope source has Device, DeviceAssociation, and CompartmentDefinition active; source/compartments.xml leaves Device without a Patient-compartment parameter and places DeviceAssociation in Patient via patient | subject | focus; Device.association remains commented out and Device narrative directs patient/device ownership/custodianship to DeviceAssociation.

related_jiras.note: Broader R5 patient-compartment cleanup whose source commit added Device subject to the Patient compartment, though the Jira resolution focused on other resources.
